style.styleTitle: Lumineo Glass LED Christmas Tree Decoration
style.toneOfVoice: Transform your indoor space into a festive wonderland with this charming Lumineo LED Tree in green. Perfect for Christmas, this tree is crafted from elegant glass and stands at 19.5 cm tall with a 10.5 cm diameter.- LED colour: warm white for a cozy ambiance- Size: 19.5 cm in height with a 10.5 cm diameter- Material: made from glass- LED size: micro, offering subtle illumination- Functions: steady glow to enhance any settingPowered by 2 AAA batteries, this tree operates for up to 48 hours and features a convenient 6-hour timer, allowing you to set it and forget it, saving you the hassle of constant switching. With 15 micro LED bulbs, it emits a warm, inviting glow, perfect for any indoor setting. The silver-coloured cable adds a sleek touch, making it a delightful addition to your décor. Ideal for those looking to add a touch of magic to any room without the fuss of wires.
